description: This Java interface defines properties and methods related to objects that can be voided in the OpenMRS system, including flags for voided status, voiding user, date voided, and reason for voiding.

methods.name: isVoided
methods.description: Deprecated method returning whether the object is voided or not.

methods.name: getVoided
methods.description: Returns whether the object is voided as a Boolean.

methods.name: setVoided
methods.description: Sets the voided status of the object.

methods.name: getVoidedBy
methods.description: Returns the user who voided the object.

methods.name: setVoidedBy
methods.description: Sets the user who voided the object.

methods.name: getDateVoided
methods.description: Returns the date when the object was voided.

methods.name: setDateVoided
methods.description: Sets the date the object was voided.

methods.name: getVoidReason
methods.description: Returns the reason for voiding the object.

methods.name: setVoidReason
methods.description: Sets the reason why the object was voided.
